## Summary

Provide a concise explanation of the changes introduced in this pull request and the motivation behind them.

Closes # (issue number if applicable)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would alter existing behavior)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Performance improvement or refactor

## Testing Checklist

- [ ] Added unit or integration tests covering the new behavior
- [ ] Verified tests pass locally (`pytest`)
- [ ] Verified linter passes (`ruff check .`)
- [ ] Verified code formatting (`ruff format --check .`)
- [ ] Verified zero credential or token leakage in tests and sample cassettes
- [ ] Updated public documentation (`README.md`, `docs/`) if applicable

## Security Considerations

- Does this change handle sensitive data (headers, query strings, bodies)?
- Have redaction rules been maintained or extended?
